reason: A GitHub integration plugin for agent-accessible repository search, code and project inspection, issue and pull request management, and other authenticated repository write operations.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供 GitHub 仓库搜索、代码与项目数据读取、议题和拉取请求管理及其他仓库操作能力。
summaries.en: Provides agents with GitHub repository search, code and project inspection, issue and pull request management, and other repository operations.

capabilities: Read GitHub repository metadata, files, issues, pull requests, comments, commits, branches, releases, tags, users, and workflow runs
Create and modify GitHub issues and comments
Create branches, write files, create releases, and create draft pull requests
Merge pull requests and star or unstar repositories
